verdict.rationale: The only voice-related evidence is release-note one-liners saying users can 'use GPT Live in meetings and calls' and get 'searchable meeting transcripts'. That points to some live voice conversation and transcription capability, but no dedicated documentation describes how it works. Missing for 10: transcription of voice notes sent via messaging channels (WhatsApp/Telegram/etc.), spoken/TTS replies, in-depth docs on live voice setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
